nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Workflow
nodes.rationale: Answers come from a scoped graph query; dirty graphify-out files are expected after hooks, and graph.json is rewritten whole on every build so large diffs are not churn.

nodes.label: Query Graph Before grep or File Reads
nodes.rationale: query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: graphify update After Code Changes
nodes.rationale: AST-only incremental update keeps the graph current with no API cost.
